blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) received recognition for its Chimes Greenhills residential development at the 2017 International Property Awards for Asia Pacific held in Bangkok, Thailand last May 25- 26, 2017. Chimes Greenhills was cited as a winner in its category – High Rise Development, reinforcing the project’s stature as top-notch home choice in its class. Chimes Greenhills was launched under the Robinsons Communities brand, with a promise of “Affordable Affluence” to its prospect clients. This enticing pitch is supported by the following elements intrinsic to the project: 1) Desirable project location – along Annapolis Street in Greenhills, the project is located very close to major shopping destinations and business districts; 2) Residents will have exclusive access to a wealth of rest and relaxation amenities such as Life Fitness Gym, Play Pod, Game Station, Private Theater, Leisure Pool, Sky Lounge, and Sky Garden; and 3) The presence of reputable Summit Hotel within the mixed-use development will add value to the development. As construction for the project is on-going, Chimes Greenhills remains as a smart choice for start-up families and young professionals looking for a value for money home option. And with the distinction of an International Property Award to its name, future homeowners of the Chimes Greenhills can take pride in coming home to an award-wining development from the country’s best property developer, RLC. Since its establishment in 1995, the International Property Awards has consistently recognized RLC’s projects. To date, Robinsons Land has received 7 recognitions from the International Property Awards. This honor, definitely sets Robinsons Land as world-renowned developer with expertise in home building spanning these categories: design quality, construction, presentation, interiors, architecture and marketing.
